name: Concierge
description: Natural-language search for your Jellyfin library — describe a film and find it, including by the lines spoken in it.
overview: Search your library the way you'd describe a film to a friend.

versions.changelog: Fixes the router sending short descriptions like 'dark comedy' to native search, where they returned nothing: a short query that names nothing in the library is now treated as a description and served by both paths. The settings search box now shows Jellyfin's own results alongside Concierge's, and the query log records the top titles returned so a search can be judged after the fact.

Enrichment now checkpoints every five batches, so cancelling or crashing a build keeps everything already paid for. Adds a per-build run log recording every model call with its tokens and cost, every step, and every item left unenriched with a reason; a progress heartbeat in the server log; and a build history panel on the settings page.

Phases 0 and 1: plugin skeleton, dual model profile system, local hybrid index with the enrichment pass, BM25 + vector retrieval with rank fusion, query router, and POST /Concierge/Search. Not yet exercised against a live server.
